versions.content: If development error detection for the Ttcan module is en- abled: The function Can_TTGetTimeMarkIRQStatus() shall raise the error CAN_- E_PARAM_POINTER and shall return E_NOT_OK if the parameter Can_TT IRQStatus is a NULL pointer.
